introduction.para: The Window menu bar option allows the user to switch among currently open VCell documents.
It also holds VCell's appearance settings, which are remembered between sessions:

list.item: Set VCell Theme chooses the look of the whole application from the themes installed, including a dark theme.
Set Font Size chooses the size of VCell's text, in points. The layout follows the text: panels, dividers, table columns and windows are scaled with it, so larger text does not get clipped.
Font... opens a dialog to choose both the font family and the size, with a sample of the result.
